title: Cloud Cost Management & FinOps for Data

scenes.title: Cloud Cost Management & FinOps for Data
scenes.narration: FinOps brings financial accountability to the cloud, helping data teams understand, attribute, and optimize the cost of storage, compute, and data movement.

scenes.title: Where Data Costs Hide
bullets: Idle compute and oversized clusters quietly burn money around the clock.
Storing every version forever in hot storage inflates the monthly bill.
Full-table scans in the warehouse can cost far more than well-partitioned queries.
scenes.narration: Data platform costs accumulate in predictable places. Compute left running or sized too large wastes money continuously. Keeping all data in expensive hot storage forever is another silent drain. And in the warehouse, scanning entire tables instead of pruned partitions can multiply query costs many times over.

scenes.title: The FinOps Loop
scenes.narration: FinOps runs as a continuous cycle. First you inform by tagging resources so spend can be attributed to teams and projects. Then you optimize by right-sizing compute and moving cold data to cheaper tiers. Finally you operate, enforcing budgets and automating the practices that keep costs in check.

scenes.title: Right-Sizing Storage with Lifecycle
scenes.narration: This S3 lifecycle rule automates storage cost savings. Objects under the logs prefix move to infrequent-access storage after thirty days and to Glacier after ninety, sharply cutting the per-gigabyte price as data ages. After a year they expire entirely. Automating this tiering means old data stops quietly inflating your bill.

scenes.title: Cost Levers for Data
scenes.narration: Cost control has two main fronts. On compute, use spot instances for tolerant batch jobs, auto-stop idle resources, and right-size clusters to the workload. On storage, tier cold data to cheaper classes, use compact columnar formats, and expire data you no longer need. Together these levers can dramatically shrink a bill.

scenes.text: FinOps makes cost a first-class engineering metric — tag spend, tier storage, right-size compute, and scan less, and your platform stays affordable as it grows.
scenes.narration: Treat cost as an engineering metric, not an afterthought. Tagging spend, tiering storage, right-sizing compute, and scanning less keep a data platform affordable even as its scale and ambition grow.
